name: verify
description: The verify role on contract v3: adversarial reproduction of defects that coding, qa, and review all missed — independent attempts with recorded outcomes and evidence, inline findings addressed to coding, never a fix. Gates enforce closed_checks against code_under_review: and the Subject: issue-<n> trailer; the role's directive and its outcome/finding/state enforcement live in the sibling verify-* plugins (verify-directive-depth, verify-outcome-gate, verify-finding-gate, verify-state-guard).
